_comment: Vendored, provenance-stamped constants taken from the COMPETITION'S
FLOW OF RECORD's own tooling (DR 0002: the Tiny Tapeout CMOS5L
template driving LibreLane through `tt-gds-action`), so this repo's
tile-budget arithmetic cites the flow that actually sizes the die
rather than an order-of-magnitude figure from a template comment.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (issue #39): every tile-budget comparison this
repo had made before 2026-09-24 used `1 tile ~= 167 x 108 um` -- the
number in the template's own `info.yaml` comment, which that comment
and this repo's records both correctly labelled an order of magnitude
with no inter-tile spacing or margin stated. The flow of record does
not use that number: `tt-support-tools`' `Project.create_user_config`
sets LibreLane's `DIE_AREA` directly from
`tech/ihp-sg13cmos5l/tile_sizes.yaml`, keyed by `info.yaml`'s `tiles`
string. Those are the die areas the submitted design is actually
hardened into, and they are between 1.7x and 2.2x the areas the
167x108 arithmetic produces. `spec/decision-records/0005-*.md` records
the correction and what it changes.
APPEND-ONLY DISCIPLINE: this file states upstream facts, not this
repo's own measurements. Re-vendor it (new `vendored` block, new
paragraph here) when the upstream ref moves; never silently edit a
value under an old provenance stamp.
